text:
Mannheim’s median asking rent sits at 12.54 €/m² in June 2026, up 3.8 % year‑on‑year and 21.2 % over the past five years, placing the city 15th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The spread between the 25th and 75th percentiles (10.88 – 14.55 €/m²) shows modest dispersion, while the average 60 m² unit costs about 752 € per month.

The market remains balanced with a 1.8 % vacancy rate and 28 days on market; 27 % of listings are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents is 16.8 %, and asking rents sit roughly 50 % above the 2022 existing‑rent level of 8.39 €/m², reflecting limited affordability.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 13.08 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 12.76 €/m² and 13.44 €/m², implying a 4.3 % increase.
